source_logloss_note: BCE uses source-dtype epsilon clipping then float64 logs; original sklearn logloss equality is not required.
bce_denominator: Actual resampled row count, not number of resampled users.
uncertainty: Exploratory 95% percentile intervals conditional on fixed checkpoints; no training-seed, multiplicity or selection correction.
interpretation: All thirteen effects retained. Task differences use paired effect differences. A significant task and an inconclusive task do not establish task heterogeneity. No winner or incumbent decision.
availability_scope: Common rows and strict masks do not establish actual online behavior/ingestion times.
source_and_input_identity_scope: Original N audit supplies the 122 full input-content SHA256 values. Production B/C runners verified input stat snapshots before and after their actual traversals, and both original metadata hashes before those traversals; this audit now verifies the 122 current stat records and two original metadata hashes. No Parquet, checkpoint or prediction array is opened or rehashed here. Model-output SHA256 values are inherited from successful production completions and matched worker/launcher receipts. Stat continuity cannot independently rule out content changes that preserve stat fields.
